How To Play:
⚔️ Place Units: Set up your units to automatically fight enemies.
💵 Earn Money: Get cash for defeating zombies.
💪 Unlock Better Units: Use your money to get stronger units.
🗺️ New Areas: Unlock new areas with stronger enemies.

📢Shutdown = Update
